local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local dc = "https://discord.gg/uCZSFpAaEZ"

task.spawn(function()

local function updateStatusGui()
  if not statusEnabled then
    if statusGui then
      statusGui.Enabled = false
    end
    return
  end
  if not statusGui then
    createStatusGui()
  end
  statusGui.Enabled = true
  if statusLabel then
    if autoOn then
      statusLabel.TextColor3 = colorOn
    else
      statusLabel.TextColor3 = colorOff
    end
  end
end
local function setAutoStatus(enabled)
  statusEnabled = enabled
  updateStatusGui()
end
local function isAlive(player)
  return player and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and player.Character.Humanoid.Health > 0
end
local function findBomb()
  local character = localPlayer.Character
  if not character then
    return nil
  end
  local bomb = character:FindFirstChild("Bomb")
  if bomb then
    return bomb
  end
  local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
  if backpack then
    local bomb2 = backpack:FindFirstChild("Bomb")
    if bomb2 then
      return bomb2
    end
  end
  return nil
end
local function getBombTimer()
  local bomb = findBomb()
  if not bomb then
    return nil
  end
  for index2, item2 in ipairs(bomb:GetDescendants()) do
    if (item2:IsA("NumberValue") or item2:IsA("IntValue")) and string.lower(item2.Name):find("time") then
      return item2.Value
    end
  end
  for index3, item3 in ipairs(bomb:GetDescendants()) do
    if item3:IsA("TextLabel") and string.lower(item3.Name):find("time") then
      local tonumberResult = tonumber(item3.Text)
      if tonumberResult then
        return tonumberResult
      end
    end
  end
  return nil
end
local function hasBomb(character)
  if not character then
    return false
  end
  return character:FindFirstChild("Bomb") ~= nil
end
local function hasSafeHighlight(character)
  if not character then
    return false
  end
  for key, descendant in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
    if descendant:IsA("Highlight") and descendant.FillColor.G > 0.9 then
      return true
    end
  end
  return false
end
local function refreshPlayerCache()
  local now = tick()
  if now - lastCacheRefresh < afCacheRefresh then
    return
  end
  lastCacheRefresh = now
  local fresh = {}
  for key, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if player ~= localPlayer then
      local alive = isAlive(player)
      local hasCharacter = player.Character ~= nil
      if alive and hasCharacter then
        fresh[player.UserId] = {
          player = player,
          alive = alive,
          hasCharacter = hasCharacter,
          inArena = true,
          lastSeen = now,
        }
      end
    end
  end
  for userId, old in pairs(playerCache) do
    if not fresh[userId] and old.alive and tick() - old.lastSeen < 3 then
      fresh[userId] = old
      fresh[userId].alive = false
    end
  end
  playerCache = fresh
end
local function getTargetablePlayers()
  refreshPlayerCache()
  local result = {}
  for key, entry in pairs(playerCache) do
    if entry.alive and entry.hasCharacter and entry.inArena then
      table.insert(result, entry.player)
    end
  end
  return result
end
local function trackBombEvents(character, player)
  character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
    if child:IsA("Tool") and child.Name == "Bomb" then
      bombChangeTimes[player] = tick()
    end
  end)
  character.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
    if child:IsA("Tool") and child.Name == "Bomb" then
      bombChangeTimes[player] = tick()
    end
  end)
end
for _, otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
  if otherPlayer.Character then
    trackBombEvents(otherPlayer.Character, otherPlayer)
  end
  otherPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
    trackBombEvents(character, otherPlayer)
  end)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
  player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
    trackBombEvents(character, player)
  end)
end)
local function getRecentBombOwner()
  local bestAge = math.huge
  local now = tick()
  local bestOwner
  for key, changedAt in pairs(bombChangeTimes) do
    if key ~= localPlayer and changedAt and now - changedAt <= recentOwnerWindow and isAlive(key) then
      local age = now - changedAt
      if age < bestAge then
        bestAge = age
        bestOwner = key
      end
    end
  end
  return bestOwner
end
local function isBlocked(ignoreInstance, rootPart, direction, distance)
  if not ignoreInstance or not rootPart then
    return false
  end
  local origin = rootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
  local params = RaycastParams.new()
  params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  local filter = {ignoreInstance}
  for key, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if player.Character then
      table.insert(filter, player.Character)
    end
  end
  params.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter
  return workspace:Raycast(origin, direction * distance, params) ~= nil
end
local function requestPath(from, to, character, rootPart)
  local now = tick()
  if now - lastPathRequest < 0.1 then
    return
  end
  lastPathRequest = now
  task.spawn(function()
    if not isBlocked(character, rootPart, (to - from).Unit, math.min((to - from).Magnitude, 10)) then
      pathWaypoint = to
      return
    end
    if pcall(function()
      path:ComputeAsync(from, to)
    end) and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
      local getWaypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
      if #getWaypoints >= 2 then
        pathWaypoint = getWaypoints[2].Position
      else
        pathWaypoint = to
      end
    else
      pathWaypoint = to
    end
  end)
end
local function getPredictedPosition(targetRoot, myRoot)
  local position = targetRoot.Position
  local assemblyLinearVelocity = targetRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity
  local flatVelocity = Vector3.new(assemblyLinearVelocity.X, 0, assemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
  local speed = flatVelocity.Magnitude
  if speed > 50 then
    flatVelocity = flatVelocity.Unit * 50
  elseif speed < 1.5 then
    return position
  end
  local lead = position + flatVelocity * math.clamp((position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude / 42, 0.12, 0.42)
  local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
  rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {targetRoot.Parent, localPlayer.Character}
  rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  local raycast = workspace:Raycast(position, lead - position, rayParams)
  if raycast then
    return raycast.Position - flatVelocity.Unit * 1.2
  end
  return lead
end
local function findBestTarget()
  local candidates = getTargetablePlayers()
  if #candidates == 0 then
    return nil
  end
  local myRoot = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not myRoot then
    return nil
  end
  local bestTarget
  local bestDistance = math.huge
  for index2, item2 in ipairs(candidates) do
    if item2.Character and not hasSafeHighlight(item2.Character) and not ignoredPlayers[item2.Name] then
      local humanoidRootPart = item2.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if humanoidRootPart then
        local distance = (humanoidRootPart.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
        if distance < bestDistance then
          bestDistance = distance
          bestTarget = item2
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return bestTarget
end
local function onToolAdded(child)
  if child:IsA("Tool") and child.Name == "Bomb" then
    local owner = getRecentBombOwner()
    if owner and isAlive(owner) then
      recentBombOwner = owner
      noRecentOwner = false
    else
      recentBombOwner = nil
      noRecentOwner = true
    end
    followDeadline = tick() + followDuration
    pausedAfterGive = false
    if autoOn then
      local newTarget = findBestTarget()
      if newTarget then
        currentTarget = newTarget
      end
    end
  end
end
local function onToolRemoved(child)
  if child:IsA("Tool") and child.Name == "Bomb" then
    currentTarget = nil
    recentBombOwner = nil
    noRecentOwner = false
    if suspendOnGive then
      pausedAfterGive = true
    end
  end
end
local function watchCharacter(character)
  character.ChildAdded:Connect(onToolAdded)
  character.ChildRemoved:Connect(onToolRemoved)
end
if localPlayer.Character then
  watchCharacter(localPlayer.Character)
end
localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
  task.wait(0.25)
  watchCharacter(character)
  currentTarget = nil
  recentBombOwner = nil
  pausedAfterGive = false
  hadBombLastFrame = false
  pathWaypoint = nil
end)
local function resetState()
  recentBombOwner = nil
  currentTarget = nil
  followDeadline = 0
  pausedAfterGive = false
  noRecentOwner = false
  hadBombLastFrame = false
  playerCache = {}
  pathWaypoint = nil
end
local function faceTarget(root, targetPos, humanoid)
  if UserInputService.MouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then
    return
  end
  local lookCFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position, Vector3.new(targetPos.X, root.Position.Y, targetPos.Z))
  local moveDir = humanoid and humanoid.MoveDirection or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
  local toTarget = Vector3.new(targetPos.X, root.Position.Y, targetPos.Z) - root.Position
  if toTarget.Magnitude < 0.01 then
    return
  end
  local unit = toTarget.Unit
  local turnSpeed = rotationSpeed
  if (moveDir.Magnitude > 0.1 and moveDir.Unit or unit):Dot(unit) < 0.4 then
    turnSpeed = turnSpeed * 1.6
  end
  root.CFrame = root.CFrame:Lerp(lookCFrame, math.clamp(turnSpeed, 0.1, 0.85))
end
local function tagTarget(targetCharacter, tool)
  local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") or tool:FindFirstChildOfClass("Part")
  if handle and targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and (localPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - targetCharacter.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude < 4.5 then
    task.spawn(function()
      local touchCount = 15
      local touchType = 1
      for i = 1, 15 do
        firetouchinterest(targetCharacter.HumanoidRootPart, handle, 0)
        firetouchinterest(targetCharacter.HumanoidRootPart, handle, 1)
      end
    end)
  end
end
local function updateFloatingButton()
  if not floatingFrame then
    return
  end
  if not systemEnabled then
    floatingFrame.Visible = false
    return
  end
  floatingFrame.Visible = true
  if recordingMode then
    floatingFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    if floatingGlow then
      floatingGlow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    end
    if floatingButton then
      floatingButton.TextTransparency = 1
    end
    for key, child in pairs(floatingFrame:GetDescendants()) do
      if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
        child.TextTransparency = 1
        continue
      end
      if child:IsA("UIGradient") then
        child.Enabled = false
      end
    end
  else
    floatingFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
    if floatingGlow then
      floatingGlow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
    end
    if floatingButton then
      floatingButton.TextTransparency = 0
    end
    for key2, child in pairs(floatingFrame:GetDescendants()) do
      if child:IsA("TextLabel") and child.Name == "Watermark" then
        child.TextTransparency = 0.3
        continue
      end
      if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
        child.TextTransparency = 0
        continue
      end
      if child:IsA("UIGradient") then
        child.Enabled = true
      end
    end
  end
  if floatingButton then
    floatingButton.Text = autoOn and "AUTO  ON" or "AUTO  OFF"
  end
  if floatingGlow then
    floatingGlow.BackgroundColor3 = autoOn and Color3.fromRGB(0, 145, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(210, 40, 55)
  end
  updateStatusGui()
end

  floatingFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0

  floatingFrame.Parent = floatingGui
  local uICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
  uICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
  uICorner.Parent = floatingFrame
  local uIGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
  uIGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(80, 40, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(0, 140, 255)),

  uIGradient.Rotation = 45
  uIGradient.Parent = floatingFrame
  floatingGlow = Instance.new("Frame")
  floatingGlow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
  floatingGlow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 145, 255)
  floatingGlow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
  floatingGlow.BorderSizePixel = 0
  floatingGlow.ZIndex = 0
  floatingGlow.Parent = floatingFrame
  local uICorner2 = Instance.new("UICorner")
  uICorner2.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
  uICorner2.Parent = floatingGlow
  local uIGradient2 = Instance.new("UIGradient")
  uIGradient2.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 255)),
  })
  uIGradient2.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.65),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.82),
  })
  uIGradient2.Rotation = 90
  uIGradient2.Parent = floatingGlow
  floatingButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
  floatingButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
  floatingButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  floatingButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
  floatingButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
  floatingButton.TextSize = 15
  floatingButton.Text = "AUTO  ON"
  floatingButton.ZIndex = 5
  floatingButton.Parent = floatingFrame
  local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  textLabel.Name = "Watermark"
  textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 11)
  textLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -12)
  textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  textLabel.Text = "PhantomX"
  textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(175, 150, 255)
  textLabel.TextSize = 9
  textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
  textLabel.TextTransparency = 0.3
  textLabel.ZIndex = 6
  textLabel.Parent = floatingFrame
  floatingButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    autoOn = not autoOn
    if not autoOn then
      currentTarget = nil
      pausedAfterGive = false
      hadBombLastFrame = false
    end
    updateFloatingButton()
  end)
  local dragging = false
  local dragStart
  local startPos
  floatingButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
      dragging = true
      dragStart = input.Position
      startPos = floatingFrame.Position
      input.Changed:Connect(function()
        if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
          dragging = false
        end
      end)
    end
  end)
  UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
      if buttonPinned then
        return
      end
      local delta = input.Position - dragStart
      local newPos = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
      floatingFrame.Position = newPos
      buttonPosition = newPos
    end
  end)
end
local resetButtonPosition = function()
  buttonPosition = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
  if floatingFrame then
    floatingFrame.Position = buttonPosition

end
local togglePin = function()
  buttonPinned = not buttonPinned
  if floatingButton then
    floatingButton.Text = (buttonPinned and "📌 " or "") .. (autoOn and "AUTO  ON" or "AUTO  OFF")
  end
end
local function setSystemEnabled(enabled)
  systemEnabled = enabled
  if enabled then
    autoOn = true
    if not floatingGui then
      createFloatingButton()
    end
  else
    autoOn = false
    currentTarget = nil
    pausedAfterGive = false
    hadBombLastFrame = false
  end
  updateFloatingButton()
end

  updateFloatingButton()

local function getPlayerOptions()
  local options = {}
  displayToUsername = {}
  for index2, item2 in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if item2 ~= localPlayer then
      local label = item2.DisplayName .. " (@" .. item2.Name .. ")"
      table.insert(options, label)
      displayToUsername[label] = item2.Name
    end
  end
  table.sort(options)
  return options
end

  Title = "Ignore Players",
  Desc = "Select players you DON'T want to chase (others will be chased)",
  Values = getPlayerOptions(),
  Value = {},
  Multi = true,
  AllowNone = true,
  SearchBarEnabled = true,
  Callback = function(selected)
    ignoredPlayers = {}
    if type(selected) == "table" then
      for index2, item2 in ipairs(selected) do
        local username = displayToUsername[item2]
        if username then
          ignoredPlayers[username] = true
        end
      end
    end
    if not autoOn then
      currentTarget = nil
    end
  end,
})

  Value = false,
  Callback = function(state)
    setAutoStatus(state)
  end,
})
autoTab:Divider()
autoTab:Section({Title = "Movement Settings"})
autoTab:Button({
  Title = "Random Settings",
  Icon = "shuffle",
  Callback = function()
    strafeDistance = math.clamp(strafeDistance + math.random(-8, 12) / 10, 5.5, 9)
    strafeAmplitude = math.clamp(strafeAmplitude + math.random(-5, 7) / 10, 0.8, 1.6)
    strafeSpeed = math.clamp(strafeSpeed + math.random(-3, 4), 13, 20)
    followDuration = math.clamp(followDuration + math.random(-8, 12) / 10, 5.5, 11)
    adhesionForce = math.clamp(adhesionForce + math.random(-3, 4) / 10, 1.6, 2.6)
    rotationSpeed = math.clamp(rotationSpeed + math.random(-3, 5) / 100, 0.32, 0.52)
    CONFIG.STRAFE_DISTANCE = strafeDistance
    CONFIG.STRAFE_AMPLITUDE = strafeAmplitude
    CONFIG.STRAFE_SPEED = strafeSpeed
    CONFIG.FOLLOW_DURATION = followDuration
    CONFIG.ADHESION_FORCE = adhesionForce
    CONFIG.ROTATION_SPEED = rotationSpeed
    task.defer(function()
      if inputElements.sDist then
        pcall(function()
          inputElements.sDist:Set(tostring(math.floor(strafeDistance * 10) / 10))
        end)
      end
      if inputElements.sAmp then
        pcall(function()
          inputElements.sAmp:Set(tostring(math.floor(strafeAmplitude * 10) / 10))
        end)
      end
      if inputElements.sSpeed then
        pcall(function()
          inputElements.sSpeed:Set(tostring(math.floor(strafeSpeed)))
        end)
      end
      if inputElements.fDur then
        pcall(function()
          inputElements.fDur:Set(tostring(math.floor(followDuration * 10) / 10))

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
  if statusEnabled and statusLabel then
    local clock = os.clock()
    if clock - lastStatusUpdate >= 0.12 then
      lastStatusUpdate = clock
      if autoOn then
        statusLabel.Text = tostring(math.random(60, 90))
        statusLabel.TextColor3 = colorOn
      else
        statusLabel.Text = tostring(math.random(20, 40))
        statusLabel.TextColor3 = colorOff
      end
    end
  end
  local character = localPlayer.Character
  if not character then
    return
  end
  local holdingBomb = hasBomb(character)
  if autoOn and holdingBomb and not hadBombLastFrame then
    currentTarget = nil
    recentBombOwner = nil
    noRecentOwner = false
    pausedAfterGive = false
    playerCache = {}
    followDeadline = tick() + followDuration
    local newTarget = findBestTarget()
    if newTarget then
      currentTarget = newTarget
    end
  end
  hadBombLastFrame = holdingBomb
  if not autoOn then
    currentTarget = nil
    pausedAfterGive = false
    return
  end
  if not holdingBomb then
    return
  end
  if paused then
    return
  end
  if not isAlive(localPlayer) then
    currentTarget = nil
    return
  end
  if autoHoldEnabled then
    local timer = getBombTimer()
    if timer and timer > autoHoldThreshold then
      local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
      if humanoidRootPart and humanoid then
        local dodgeTarget = findBestTarget()
        if dodgeTarget and dodgeTarget.Character then
          local humanoidRootPart2 = dodgeTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          if humanoidRootPart2 then
            local toTarget = humanoidRootPart2.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position
            if toTarget.Magnitude <= autoHoldDodgeDistance then
              local awayDir = -Vector3.new(toTarget.X, 0, toTarget.Z).Unit
              humanoidRootPart.CFrame = humanoidRootPart.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.new(humanoidRootPart.Position, humanoidRootPart.Position + awayDir), rotationSpeed)
              humanoid:MoveTo(humanoidRootPart.Position + awayDir * 3 + Vector3.new(-awayDir.Z, 0, awayDir.X) * math.sin(tick() * strafeSpeed) * strafeAmplitude)
            end
          end
        end
      end
      return
    end
  end
  local candidate = findBestTarget()
  if candidate and candidate ~= currentTarget then
    if not currentTarget then
      currentTarget = candidate
      followDeadline = tick() + followDuration
    else
      local humanoidRootPart3 = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local currentRoot = currentTarget.Character and currentTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local candidateRoot = candidate.Character and candidate.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if humanoidRootPart3 and currentRoot and candidateRoot and (candidateRoot.Position - humanoidRootPart3.Position).Magnitude < (currentRoot.Position - humanoidRootPart3.Position).Magnitude - 3.5 then
        currentTarget = candidate
        followDeadline = tick() + followDuration
      end
    end
  end
  if pausedAfterGive then
    if tick() > followDeadline + 1 then
      pausedAfterGive = false
      currentTarget = findBestTarget()
      if currentTarget then
        followDeadline = tick() + followDuration
      end
    end
    return
  end
  if tick() >= followDeadline or not currentTarget or not isAlive(currentTarget) then
    local replacement = findBestTarget()
    if replacement then
      currentTarget = replacement
      followDeadline = tick() + followDuration
    else
      currentTarget = nil
    end
  end
  if currentTarget and character and currentTarget.Character then
    local humanoidRootPart4 = currentTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoidRootPart5 = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid2 = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if humanoidRootPart4 and humanoidRootPart5 and humanoid2 then
      local distance = (humanoidRootPart4.Position - humanoidRootPart5.Position).Magnitude
      if distance > 55 then
        currentTarget = findBestTarget()
        return
      end
      local predicted = getPredictedPosition(humanoidRootPart4, humanoidRootPart5)
      local toPredicted = predicted - humanoidRootPart5.Position
      faceTarget(humanoidRootPart5, predicted, humanoid2)
      if distance > adhesionForce then
        local goal = predicted - toPredicted.Unit * adhesionForce
        if distance <= strafeDistance and distance > 3 then
          local sideways = Vector3.new(-toPredicted.Z, 0, toPredicted.X)
          if sideways.Magnitude == 0 then
            sideways = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
          end
          goal = goal + sideways.Unit * (math.sin(tick() * strafeSpeed) * strafeAmplitude)
        end
        if distance < 8 then
          pathWaypoint = nil
          humanoid2:MoveTo(goal)
        else
          requestPath(humanoidRootPart5.Position, goal, character, humanoidRootPart5)
          local moveTarget = pathWaypoint or goal
          local moveDelta = moveTarget - humanoidRootPart5.Position
          if Vector3.new(moveDelta.X, 0, moveDelta.Z).Magnitude > 0.5 then
            humanoid2:MoveTo(moveTarget)
            if isBlocked(character, humanoidRootPart5, Vector3.new(0, -1, 0), 3) then
              humanoid2.Jump = true
            end
          else
            humanoid2:MoveTo(goal)
          end
        end
      else
        humanoid2:MoveTo(humanoidRootPart5.Position + toPredicted.Unit * 0.1)
      end
      local tool = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
      if tool then
        tagTarget(currentTarget.Character, tool)
      end
    end
  end
end)

  end

  end
end)
